verdict.rationale: Codegen's API docs list triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail [codegen-docs-18]. Its agents can fix bugs and open pull requests [codegen-docs-16, codegen-docs-24], and an endpoint to ban checks and stop related agents suggests check-driven agent runs exist [codegen-docs-34]. However, the documented path is an API trigger you must wire into your own pipeline, not a turnkey auto-fix for failed workflows, and the evidence is one-line claims only. Missing for 10: a native, documented auto-trigger on failed GitHub checks, a detailed CI-failure diagnosis workflow, an end-to-end failed-CI-to-PR example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
